letter.text:
A tablet has been left at the gate with your name on the outside and Hannu's hand on the inside.

It says: the seal was opened before it reached the island. Say nothing. Come to the gate at the second hour, and if I am not there, do not come again.

gate.text: He is not there. The wall is in shadow and the second hour comes and goes, and a scribe you do not know watches you from the gate and writes nothing down.

choices.text: Walk back down to the harbor.

burn.text: The tablet does not burn well. It cracks, and the pieces go into the water, and the harbor keeps its own accounts.
